subject: Request for temporary burst uplift + latency SLO during SyncWave launch
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex@syncwavehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for temporary burst uplift + latency SLO during SyncWave launch

Hi Stephanie —

We're launching a new real-time triage feature next week (public rollout on 2026-09-03 08:00 PT) and expect a short, concentrated spike in inference traffic for roughly 72 hours following the rollout. Baseline request volume today is ~2.4k rps; forecasted peak is 24k rps over several 10–15 minute bursts.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a temporary increase to our burst allowance (target: 2x current burst window capacity) for the 72-hour launch window?
- Can we get a committed 95th percentile latency SLO of <=200ms for text-generation endpoints during that period (we understand there may be an uplift surcharge).

We attached our traffic forecast and an initial mutual action plan to this thread. If you can put the proposed uplift and any operational conditions in writing (pre-warm, caching recommendations, failover model), we can sign and share billing contact info.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Park
Head of Platform Engineering, SyncWave Health
attachments: SyncWave_launch_traffic_forecast.csv, Mutual_Action_Plan_SyncWave.xlsx

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@syncwavehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for temporary burst uplift + latency SLO during SyncWave launch

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and the attachments. 

We can support a temporary uplift for launch week, but I need to confirm operational constraints with Ops. Quick summary of what I need to validate and what I recommend we include in the MA plan:
- Exact start/end timestamps for the 72-hour window (please confirm timezone -> PT ok).
- Whether you can provide a short-lived API key for the uplift (preferred) or whether we should operate by IP allowlist.
- Model fallback: specify which model variants are acceptable if latency spikes (we recommend the 7B quantized variant as fallback).
- Pre-warm procedure: traffic ramp and test schedule so we can pre-populate KV caches.

Marissa, looping you for commercial terms (surcharge / invoice) and Soojin for operations signoff.

I can draft an amendment to the MA plan once Ops confirms feasibility.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for temporary burst uplift + latency SLO during SyncWave launch

Thanks for the heads up — reviewed the forecast. Operations can provide a time-limited uplift with the following conditions: 

1) Scope & duration
   - Uplift window: 2026-09-03T08:00:00-07:00 to 2026-09-06T08:00:00-07:00 (72 hours).
2) Technical constraints
   - We will apply a temporary burst multiplier of 2x on your current burst allowance.
   - 95th percentile latency target: best-effort <=200ms; SLA credit not guaranteed for transient infra events.
   - To protect cluster stability, your requests during the window will be assigned a reduced fairness weight (priority lowered relative to Dedicated customers).
3) Required prep
   - Pre-warm run on 2026-09-02 between 10:00–12:00 PT: you ramp to 50% peak while we warm caches.
   - Provide an API key to scope the uplift (we will not change global account limits).
4) Commercials & billing
   - Uplift surcharge = 15% on top of per-token/embedding usage for the uplifted window. One-off operational fee: $2,500.

Action items for this thread (internal + external):
- SyncWave: confirm start time and provide API key (DevOps contact).
- Stephanie / Marissa: prepare a short amendment for signature (MA plan + surcharge).
- Karthik: readiness checklist for observability toggles and alerting.

We can provision the uplift once the signed amendment and API key are received.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

Stephanie / Soojin —

Thanks for the quick review and the clear conditions. We accept the terms outlined by Soojin. Confirming:
- Start: 2026-09-03T08:00 PT; End: 2026-09-06T08:00 PT.
- We'll provide a scoped API key by EOD 2026-08-31 and will run the pre-warm on 2026-09-02 10:00–12:00 PT.
- DevOps contact: Priya Ramesh <priya.r@syncwavehealth.com>.

I've attached an updated MA plan with signatures and the expected traffic shape. Please send the amendment/invoice and a DocuSign link for the uplift addendum.

Alex
